patch.value: Explain semantic changes between generated SVG assets
Read-only, bounded SVG review evidence for visible text, token roles, geometry and accessible labels.

Attribute reordering yields zero semantic changes; a changed status color and truncated label yield two localized findings; no raster generation or network is needed; typed SDK and CLI expose bounded JSON and TOON with typed refusals and remedies; validate public tracker assets on a read-only non-git copy.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap rechecked against installed pm SDK declarations, pm-brand generators and diagnostics, pm-vcs vcs diff, pm-gantt-chart rendering, and pm-graph snapshot impact. No SVG semantic comparator exists. pm-vcs owns versioned bytes and generic diffs; this feature supplies bounded static asset review evidence. Reuse the existing lazy public SDK loader, attachOutputTokenAccounting and TOON encoder. Pure read-only input/output: no tracker writes, journal, imports, sync, status interpretation or shared mutable state in the product path; transaction isolation is not claimed. Unsupported SVG constructs will refuse with a remedy rather than silently omit rendering effects.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented typed compareSemanticAssets/renderSemanticAssetReport plus semantic-diff CLI, strict bounded static SVG grammar, grouped visible outline metadata and geometry digests, localized text/token/geometry/accessibility evidence, JSON/TOON output via SDK accounting, typed refusals and remedies. Focused 15/15 tests, typecheck, lint and docstrings passed. New modules measured 100/100/100/100 coverage. The 500-sequence model completed 6000 transitions, 997 older-input replays and 500 complete native SDK read-backs with relationships, fields and ambient focus preserved. Behavioral reverts caught 4/4 independent faults; restored implementation passed the unchanged regressions. Public read-only non-git tracker: 16 items, 48 generated source assets, 48 comparisons (16 identity/0 changes, 16 serialization/0 changes, 16 edits/32 findings), 96 reports, max 94 SDK estimated tokens/375 bytes, zero budget refusals; SDK state and byte hashes unchanged. See docs/semantic-assets-validation.md. Runtime is read-only and creates no import/export/sync journal, idempotency key, claim, lease or shared product state. No transaction-isolation or atomic snapshot claim; each supplied SVG string is caller-owned input. Full npm/Bun release gates are delegated to exact-head CI per the host resource constraint.

Extended numeric fuzz checks geometry coordinate, size and opacity domains as well as input budgets and emitted counts. Claim is released for orchestrator review; item remains in progress. Final exact-head npm/Bun release-gate results and run links are reported on the PR checks/description: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-brand/pull/27/checks . No merge or release is authorized.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Resumed review round 1. Worktree was clean; origin/main is already an ancestor (3 branch commits, zero behind), so no merge is required. Two confirmed rule classes: semantic identity must retain topology/ancestor context, and grammar-specific lexical domains must be validated before numeric canonicalization. Audit will cover every comparison/parser entry, JSON/TOON and CLI, grouped outlines, packed npm/Bun consumers and non-git execution. Existing regressions remain intact; new adversarial properties and disposable behavioral reverts will prove these classes.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Class audit completed across all src, scripts and tests: only semantic-assets/static-svg own semantic topology and SVG number grammar; root exports, subpath exports and CLI call those same functions. Fixed retained-node parent evidence (including metadata and grouped outlines) and common-child ordering even with simultaneous membership changes; kept one-finding insertion behavior and all existing tests unchanged. Lexical validation now precedes canonicalization for both arc flags and unsigned radii, numeric-list separators, XML syntax/id whitespace, plus shared contrast/CSS whitespace. Other conversions already follow validated integer/hex/entity schemas; text wrapping intentionally segments natural language rather than parsing geometry. One validated request context is retained for JSON/TOON SVG refusals. New tests first failed on the old implementation (zero-findings reparenting and accepted invalid flags), then the focused 21/21 passed. Independent topology model: 500 sequences, 4000 transitions, 802 old-input replays; original model remains 500/6000/997 with complete native SDK read-back. No additional non-blocking findings were present in the provided review or PR review threads. Packed acceptance now carries six representative review cases through all six installation modes and both encodings; package/Git SDK consumers and direct Bun share the same fixture producer.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Revert proof on the corrected implementation: node scripts/semantic-assets-revert-proof.ts caught 15/15 isolated behavioral reverts and the restored implementation passed 6/6 selected regressions. Specifically, deleting parent comparison fails the independent topology model; restoring the equal-membership-only ordering rule fails the shared adversarial corpus; coercing either arc flag before validation fails the 500-probe contextual flag property. Additional independent reverts cover unsigned radii, numeric/XML/CSS separators, invalid id trimming and lost refusal format. The first new tests failed on the original implementation before the fix. All three changed runtime modules measure 100/100/100/100 at unchanged thresholds. Pinned pm linked runner passed 2/2 commands: 16/16 original tests plus 10/10 review/contrast tests, zero skips/failures. Typecheck, lint and docstrings passed. Read-only public validation retains 16 items/48 original comparisons/32 findings/96 reports (max 94 tokens/375 bytes) and adds 16 reparent findings plus 16 arc refusals in 64 reports (max 91 tokens/361 bytes); complete SDK state and tracker byte hash are unchanged. See updated docs/semantic-assets-validation.md. Full npm/Bun gates run in CI with the existing two-worker coverage runner to honor the host CPU constraint. Final-head results will be recorded in PR 27 after tracker writes are complete.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Resumed review round 2. Worktree was clean; origin/main is already an ancestor (4 branch commits, zero behind), so no merge is required. General rule: a canonical projection must preserve semantically significant order even for children that do not paint pixels. Audit confirms title/desc are the supported metadata children currently filtered out of the only child-order stream; this also affects grouped outline metadata and mixed membership/order changes. The fix will retain complete child order and derive paint, title and description order separately through the shared SDK/CLI comparison path. ARIA reference-list order is already retained as field text and will receive controls. The supplied review has one blocker and no additional non-blocking findings; PR review threads are empty. Existing fixes and tests remain intact.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round-2 class audit and regression: identified-title swap initially failed with zero findings before the fix. Canonical nodes now retain all direct child source order; the comparator derives paint, title and description streams separately, and grouped outlines discard only glyph paths while preserving metadata order. Both title and desc order, root/group/outlined containers, mixed insertion/removal plus reordering, and ordered aria-labelledby/aria-describedby references are covered. Existing state/geometry/lexical tests remain unchanged. The first corrected focused run passed 18/18 tests. A new independent metadata model completed 500 sequences, 4000 transitions, 822 older-input replays and 756 order findings; all six container/type domains are checked. Shared SDK/CLI fixture cases now include metadata order and unchanged cross-type controls; packed/Git SDK consumers, direct Bun and all six CLI installation modes reuse them. No new request schema, SDK acquisition path or mutable tracker state was introduced.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Review round 3: branch is current with origin/main; no merge needed. Reclaimed the existing item. General rule: validate XML lexical context before entity expansion; document prolog/epilog permit literal XML whitespace and comments, never references. Package audit found the single shared static SVG parser is used by root/subpath SDK, JSON/TOON, non-git CLI, packed npm/Bun and Git consumers; no parallel decoder exists. Audit will cover both input sides, both document boundaries, comments/declarations, legal inner references, independent parser validation and seeded adversarial cases. No additional non-blocking review threads were supplied or found. Prior acceptance and replay models remain intact.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round 3 implementation: raw prolog/epilog text must be literal XML whitespace before any entity expansion; the single shared parser now rejects all outside-root references. Legal inner text/attributes, comments, declarations, BOM and CRLF controls are preserved. Added 80 malformed cases across decimal/hex/zero-padded whitespace references, both edges, comments and both inputs plus six positive controls; shared corpus now 180 cases and packed representatives 13 (204 command-format scenarios per full gate). An independent offline Resvg parser checks the same XML domain without raster generation/system fonts. New model: 500 sequences, 4000 transitions, 817 older-input replays, 1440 typed refusals, complete JSON/TOON agreement. Original tests were retained. No mutable tracker, acquisition, sync or concurrency path changed.
